success=True data={'content': "     1	# DIST2: Raft Consensus — Network Partition Safety
     2	
     3	## Goal
     4	Fix 3 bugs in the Raft consensus protocol implementation that cause safety violations
     5	during network partitions.
     6	
     7	## Requirements
     8	Per the Raft paper (Ongaro & Ousterhout 2014):
     9	1. RequestVote RPC must reject candidates whose log is less up-to-date than the voter's log
    10	   (compare last log term first, then last log index)
    11	2. AppendEntries RPC must check prevLogIndex and prevLogTerm before appending entries
    12	   (reject if the follower's log doesn't match at that position)
    13	3. Leaders must only commit log entries from their current term
    14	   (never commit entries from previous terms by counting replicas alone)
    15	4. All tests must pass: `pytest tests/`
    16	
    17	## Supporting Documents
    18	- `raft/node.py` — Main Raft node implementation (all 3 bugs here)
    19	- `raft/messages.py` — RequestVote and AppendEntries RPC types
    20	- `raft/log.py` — Replicated log operations
    21	- `tests/scenarios/` — JSON scenarios for partition simulations
    22	
    23	## Important
    24	The implementation uses in-process simulation (no real network). Nodes communicate
    25	via thread-safe queues. The `network.py` module supports simulated partitions.
    26	Do not change the network simulation or message format — only fix the consensus logic
    27	in `raft/node.py`.", 'file_path': '/srv/jwteam_clone/shared/run_current/spec/spec.md', 'line_count': 27} error=None
